funder_origin_name: Anna-Greta and Holger Crafoord's Fund (1980 Crafoord donation to the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences)
funder_current_name: Anna-Greta and Holger Crafoord's Fund (Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences) with contributions from the Crafoord Foundation, Lund
funding_share_basis: The 1980 donation went to the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, which holds it as the ring-fenced Anna-Greta and Holger Crafoord's Fund (approx. SEK 180 million today; further Crafoord donations added later). The Crafoord Foundation states the purse and the research grants are financed "partly through donations from Anna-Greta and Holger Crafoord, partly through contributions from the Crafoord Foundation" (Crafoordska stiftelsen, Lund, founded 1980 by Holger Crafoord, capital SEK 5.3bn at end-2024); neither side publishes its share, but both are private Crafoord philanthropic vehicles, so the >50% majority is Philanthropy/Sweden in either state and no handover ever occurred.
money_note: Purse is SEK 8 million (2026 award, geosciences, to Veerabhadran Ramanathan), up from SEK 6 million in 2020; paid from the Academy-held Anna-Greta and Holger Crafoord's Fund together with contributions from the Crafoord Foundation in Lund.
status_note: Continuously awarded since 1982, but geosciences comes up only in the four-field rotation (mathematics/astronomy, polyarthritis, geosciences, biosciences): geoscience prizes were given in 1983, 1986, 1992, 1995, 1998, 2002, 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018, 2022 and 2026, so gaps in a geosciences winner list are by design, not missing data.
evidence_quote: "Prissumman och forskningsanslagen finansieras dels genom donationer av Anna-Greta och Holger Crafoord, dels genom bidrag fran Crafoordska stiftelsen." ("Kungliga Vetenskapsakademien mottog 1980 en forsta donation fran makarna Crafoord.")
judgment_reason: Two judgment calls. (1) Awarding body: the prize is formally awarded "in partnership between the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences and the Crafoord Foundation in Lund", so a coder could name the Crafoord Foundation (Philanthropy); I chose the Academy because it selects the laureates and confers the prize. (2) Current funder: the endowment paying the purse is held and administered by the Academy, so it could be coded Society, but it is a named, ring-fenced Crafoord fund topped up by the separate Crafoord Foundation, so the protocol's bequest tie-breaker gives Philanthropy. The Crafoord Foundation's capital originated in Gambro shares Holger Crafoord donated personally, since sold, so it is a donor vehicle (Philanthropy), not Corporate.
